description: Defines the SecurityAgent class and related nested classes, interfaces, and methods for security and authentication functionalities within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: SecurityAgent
classes.description: Main class implementing security and authentication interfaces, managing tokens, configuration, and request processing.

classes.name: TokenDispatcher
classes.description: Handles IPC communication for token management, including creation and registration of token data.

classes.name: Tokenize
classes.description: Implements Core::IIPCServer for tokenization procedures within IPC channels.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: JSON container for configuration parameters such as ACL and connector paths.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates an authentication token of specified length from buffer.

methods.name: Officer
methods.description: Retrieves security interface associated with a token.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Attaches deserializable data to incoming web requests.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and returns responses.

methods.name: endpoint_createtoken
methods.description: Creates a token via JSON-RPC (conditional compilation).
